verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a true bulk operation is a support-doc title, "Import Users from a CSV", which indicates batch creation of many users at once. Alert grouping, deduplication and per-incident workflows are automation features rather than user-initiated bulk actions, and the REST API is only a building block, so none of these earn credit. missing for 10: bulk actions on incidents (mass acknowledge/resolve/reassign), bulk edits across services/schedules/other objects, AI/MCP-driven bulk operations, detailed docs beyond a page title, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
